def: A container described by the open Development Container Specification (devcontainer.json) that packages a project's tools and settings, so editors, terminals and agents run inside it instead of on the host.
practice: Supported by VS Code, GitHub Codespaces and JetBrains IDEs; a common place to run a coding agent with prompts bypassed, paired with an egress firewall and no host secrets mounted, though anything inside it can still be exfiltrated.
